subject: Re: Pilot credits + activation timeline
messages:
From: Leah Kim <leah@cardinallabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@cardinallabs.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pilot credits + activation timeline

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. Cardinal Labs was accepted into the Velocity Accelerator and we have a cohort milestone coming up in early September. We’ve used the trial credits you provided (attached usage CSV) and are seeing steady token consumption as we ramp our synthetic tests.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a conditional extension/top-up of pilot credits so we can cover the next three weeks of heavier load and a staged demo with the accelerator investors? We’re specifically requesting an additional 30k token-equivalent credit pool and a one-month trial extension tied to these milestones:
- Demo to accelerator mentors (scheduled by 8/10)
- Attach final integration checklist and brief security overview by 8/3

Attached: cardinal_usage_q2.csv, accelerator_acceptance.pdf (acceptance letter). Happy to share more telemetry if helpful.

Leah Kim
Head of Product Ops, Cardinal Labs
leah@cardinallabs.com
+1 415 555 0133

--
Cardinal Labs — "making structured data conversational"

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Leah Kim <leah@cardinallabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credits + activation timeline

Leah — really appreciate the context and congrats on Velocity.

High level: we can support a conditional top-up and short extension. Proposed ask/ops play:
1) 30k token-equivalent top-up granted up-front, valid for 30 days.
2) Additional 30k tokens released on completion of the demo (internal verification: demo recording + short usage reconciliation).
3) We’ll keep billing triggers disabled while credits are active; normal billing resumes after credits are exhausted/expire.

I’m looping in Marissa from Customer Onboarding to run the MMP (mutual action plan) and confirm demo slot details. Two quick requests on our side before we finalize:
- Can you share a short list of the exact endpoints and peak concurrency you expect during the demo (so we can review routing/kv-cache sizing)?
- Any compliance evidence required by your accelerator? (SOC2 scoped items or data-retention constraints)

Attaching our internal ops play doc; Marissa will follow up with the MMP template. If that all sounds fine, I’ll escalate to Ben for approval on the credit signal and accounting hold.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Exec — Startup Programs, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0199

Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Ops play and approval: Cardinal Labs pilot top-up

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the usage CSV and accelerator acceptance doc. Operationally we can support the request with the following ops-play checklist (condensed):
- Grant 30k token top-up now (promo code: ONRAMP-CL-30K), set expiry 30 days from grant.
- Place credit flag on account to pause billing while promo tokens remain.
- Add staged release rule: additional 30k pending demo evidence upload (recording + short checklist).
- Require PO or accelerator confirmation email for finance to accept any further extension beyond 60 days.

I’ve attached the ops-playbook-credit-signal.pdf which has the step-by-step runbook for provisioning and the rollback flow if we see anomalous requests. Approvals required: Sales Lead (Jonas) + CS Lead (Marissa) — once the two approve I’ll ask Finance to create the credit memo and update HubSpot (link below) and the customer record.

Ben Carter
Director, Growth Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0144

Attachments: ops-playbook-credit-signal.pdf

Date: Sun, 23 Jul 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ops play and approval: Cardinal Labs pilot top-up

Thanks Jonas + Ben — this looks great and we accept the conditional plan. Per your checklist: we will upload the demo recording and checklist to the shared Drive folder by 2028-08-12. Peak concurrency for the demo will be ~8 concurrent connections hitting the chat endpoint; expected burst tokens ~18k over the 30-minute demo.

We’ll also share the accelerator compliance appendix tomorrow. Please confirm when the initial 30k top-up is applied so we can run a smoke test against our staging integration.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the demo.

Leah
